purpose: Own the just-in-time personalized Checkpoint workflow while the Unit Assessment Plan owns exact learning content, the Portfolio owns current evidence need, and the reviewed Unit Bank owns question-family architecture.
name: Checkpoint

scope.student_label_rule: Show exact I Can code + full exact I Can statement with every question.
scope.normal_use_timing: Generate only when the teacher is ready to use it so the newest Portfolio state can guide targeting.

source_of_truth.bank_gate: Selected Unit Bank must be COMPLETE, ready_for_downstream=true, and qa=PASS. Fail closed rather than inventing question families.

selection_modes: students needing evidence for a specific I Can
students needing another independent demonstration for a specific I Can

targeting.principle: Portfolio decides what evidence is useful now; the Bank supplies how that evidence is elicited.
priority_order_when_request_does_not_for: review-flagged targets when teacher judgment supports another clean look
SECURE only when needed for balanced confirmation or legitimate extension
targeting.normal_i_can_span: Usually 2-3 target I Cans across six questions, adjusted when the selected mode intentionally focuses on one I Can.
targeting.family_rule: Choose any approved Bank family whose evidence job fits the student's current need. Family letters do not carry a universal A/B/C role or stage meaning.
targeting.fresh_instance_rule: Instantiate a fresh question from the approved family architecture. Prefer deterministic/seeded generation when the family contract supports it safely; otherwise author a fresh reviewed instance. Do not invent a new architecture when an approved family fits.
targeting.teacher_note_rule: A teacher note may tune surface choices, emphasis, or print practicality but may not silently override exact I Can learning content or create unsupported evidence claims.

independence.same_i_can_repeated_questions: Multiple questions for one I Can within the same Checkpoint may provide richer evidence but normally count as one source opportunity for that I Can, not multiple independent opportunities.

offline_generation.reproducibility_rule: When deterministic generation is used, the saved source map must contain enough seed/parameter data to reproduce the printed question.

output.html_teacher_run_summary: screen-only; show resolved student membership and per-student I Can/family plan before printing
print_style: exact I Can code and statement visible with each question
output.run_folder_rule: Create a unique dated/run-specific child folder. Never overwrite an older Checkpoint run.

source_map.portfolio_ingestion_rule: When later Checkpoint evidence is ingested, the private source map saved with that run is the primary lineage authority. Map the clean printed task before judging handwriting.

privacy.drive_resolution_rule: Resolve live roster, statuses, intervention groups, and evidence from the canonical private Drive only when the request executes.
